name: What kind of financing options are available for a home addition?

mainEntity.name: What kind of financing options are available for a home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common financing options for home additions include a home equity loan, a home equity line of credit (HELOC), or a cash-out refinance. A home equity loan provides a lump sum with a fixed interest rate, while a HELOC offers a revolving credit line. A cash-out refinance replaces your existing mortgage with a new, larger one. Some homeowners also opt for construction loans, which are specifically designed for building projects. We recommend consulting with a financial advisor to determine the best option for your situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Financing options include home equity loans, HELOCs, cash-out refinances, or construction loans. Consult a financial advisor to find the best fit.
